about.title: About
about.webCrawlerBody: Indexes website content for your knowledge base.

results.successHint: The web crawler is now running in the background.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.companyNote: Access to the company knowledge base is controlled by group roles.

visibility.label: Visibility
visibility.help: Public allows all users in your organization to view this knowledge base. Editors still must be explicitly granted.

viewers.label: Viewers (user IDs or emails)
viewers.placeholder: Type an email or ID then press Add/Enter
viewers.invalid: These viewers look unusual as emails: {{items}}

editors.label: Editors (user IDs or emails)

permissions.publicSuffix: knowledge base. Anyone in your organization can view it.
permissions.personalSuffix: knowledge base. Only you have access.

delete.title: Delete Knowledge Base
delete.warningBody: This action permanently deletes this knowledge base configuration and its membership settings. Files previously uploaded remain in S3 but will no longer be associated with this KB.
delete.confirmSuffix: cannot be undone. To confirm, type the knowledge base name below:

bulkDelete.title: Confirm Deletion
bulkDelete.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete the selected items?
bulkDelete.warning_one: This will permanently delete {{count}} file and its metadata.
bulkDelete.warning_other: This will permanently delete {{count}} files and their metadata.

errors.folderExists: A folder with that name already exists here
